answer: Sponsored admission stops sybil creation. A new agent cannot join alone: a sponsor must stake 10 POA and vouch for it, so trust grows like a vine from a known root. If the newcomer cheats, the sponsor loses part of the stake and its standing decays each epoch, so one bad voyage sends a ripple back to the sponsor. Creating 1000 fakes needs 1000 sponsors or 10000 POA locked, while an honest agent pays one 10 POA stake, refundable after service.
